rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: CData Connect AI provides a fully managed MCP platform that connects to enterprise data sources including Salesforce, Snowflake, NetSuite, and hundreds of other systems. The server enables real-time read and write access through semantic data models that preserve metadata and relationships across sources. Features include granular permissions, audit trails, and point-and-click configuration for multi-source data analysis workflows.
